en: The image depicts a black-and-white winter scene with several people, likely soldiers or guards, standing in a snow-covered park or courtyard. In the background, there is a large, ornate building with arched windows and classical architecture, partially obscured by leafless trees. The people in the foreground are dressed in long coats, suggesting cold weather. There is handwriting in blue and black ink on the bottom part of the postcard.
